body.x: PurrSong Inc. (CEO Taegu Noh) showcased its latest innovation, the ‘LavvieTAG Pro,’ at CES 2025, held in Las Vegas from January 7 to 10 (local time), as part of the Incheon IFEZ Pavilion.

PurrSong specializes in IoT solutions and appliances for pets, creating a comprehensive ecosystem for pet healthcare in collaboration with experts from various fields. Its devices are connected to the proprietary ‘PurrSong’ app, which collects and analyzes data. These insights can be shared with pet owners and veterinary clinics, offering a seamless, professional approach to pet health management. The company aims to ensure happier, healthier lives for pets and their owners through advanced, user-friendly technology.

At CES 2025, PurrSong introduced the upgraded ‘LavvieTAG Pro,’ a lightweight pet activity tracker weighing just 15 grams and featuring a 3–4 month battery life. The device captures detailed data on cats’ activities, including walking, running, sleeping, eating, scratching, and vomiting behaviors. By recording and monitoring daily activities, the LavvieTAG Pro enables the detection of early health issues, supporting timely interventions and long-term well-being.

body.cap: PurrSong's representative during an interview with AVING News reporter Alex Sigrist at CES 2025. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: The LavvieTAG Pro also features real-time BLE-based location tracking, addressing concerns about lost or runaway cats. Users can locate their pets and review up to a week of movement history, offering robust solutions to unexpected situations.

A PurrSong representative stated, “Our participation at CES 2025 aims to connect with global buyers, businesses, and potential partners who can integrate our smart tag network into their solutions. We are open to collaborations to enhance product features and expand our reach into new markets.”

The company highlighted its achievements, noting that it has participated in CES three times before (2019, 2020, and 2022), earning Innovation Awards each time. These accolades and features in major international publications have facilitated partnerships and MOUs with companies in the U.S., Japan, and China.

PurrSong plans to use feedback from global attendees at CES 2025 to refine its products further. The company will then accelerate its expansion into domestic and international markets through its proprietary online store and e-commerce platforms.
AVING News, which has covered CES for 20 consecutive years, continues to support the global ambitions of Korean SMEs and startups through various initiatives.

Before CES 2025, AVING hosted a series of Global Media Meetups featuring aspiring SMEs in Korea. The Meetups introduced Korean SMEs’ technologies, products, and services to media worldwide, expanding connections between the Korean industry and global media. Geekspin, Ubergizmo, Interesting Engineering, and Le Café du Geek participated in these meetups.
During CES 2025, AVING established the AVING Broadcasting Zone at The Venetian Hotel in Las Vegas, interviewing CES Innovation Award 2025 winners.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host a review conference with participating companies in Korea, offering them a platform to gain further recognition and enhance their corporate image.
